verdict.rationale: incident.io ships AI agents (Investigations), so letting users plug external MCP servers into it is a fair question. The evidence only documents incident.io's own MCP server, which lets outside AI assistants connect to incident.io data. That is the server role, not the client role, so it does not count here, and nothing shows incident.io's agents consuming tools from user-supplied MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
